# aap_eda_decision_environment (Resource)

Manages an EDA Decision Environment resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aap_organization" "example-container-registry" {
  name = "Example Organization for Container Registry"
}
data "aap_eda_credential_type" "example-container-registry" {
  name = "Container Registry"
}
resource "aap_eda_credential" "example-container-registry" {
  name               = "%[3]s"
  description        = "%[4]s"
  organization_id    = aap_organization.example-container-registry.eda_id
  credential_type_id = data.aap_eda_credential_type.example-container-registry.id
  inputs = jsonencode({
    "host" : "quay.io",
    "password" : "test1234",
    "username" : "test",
    "verify_ssl" : true,
  })
}
resource "aap_eda_decision_environment" "example-container-registry" {
  name              = "Example Decision Environment with Container Registry"
  description       = "Example Description"
  image_url         = "quay.io/ansible/aap-latest"
  eda_credential_id = aap_eda_credential.example-container-registry.id
  organization_id   = aap_organization.example-container-registry.eda_id
  pull_policy       = "always"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the EDA Decision Environment.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization ID for the EDA Decision Environment.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the EDA Decision Environment.
- `eda_credential_id` (Number) The EDA credential ID associated with the EDA Decision Environment.
- `image_url` (String) The image URL for the EDA Decision Environment.
- `pull_policy` (String) The pull policy for the EDA Decision Environment. Either `always` or `never`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the EDA Decision Environment.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import aap_eda_decision_environment.example 1
```
